series.title: The Veer N Shoot Offense

qbs.name: Ole Miss
qbs.logo: art/Veer N Shoot Offense__Ole Miss Logo 1.webp
qbs.pitch: Lane Kiffin took the Briles tree to Oxford. The install drops in here when the video is out.

copy: Art Briles built it at Stephenville and Houston and turned it loose at Baylor: receivers split to the numbers, option routes that read the coverage after the snap, tempo, and a quarterback who runs. The most explosive offense college football had seen.

The tree kept growing. Lane Kiffin ran it at Ole Miss and Josh Heupel runs it at Tennessee. Three teams, one offense: the Baylor and Tennessee installs are ready now, and the Ole Miss install drops in beside them when the video is out.
series.bookLine: In College Football 27 all three run out of the AUBURN playbook

home.pitch: Five defensive backs to match the speed, still stout enough to stop the run. Match coverage as the base, and pressure that looks exactly like it.

book.note: every front and every call on the sheet lives inside it

principles.title: ADVANCED COVERAGE SHELLS
principles.blurb: Match coverage as the base, zone mixed off it, so the picture never repeats.

principles.title: DISGUISE EVERYTHING
principles.blurb: Blitzes and coverages look identical pre-snap. They never know what is coming.

principles.title: BUILT TO STOP THE SPREAD
principles.blurb: Five DBs to match the speed, still strong up front against the run.

home.pitch: The coverage rules under both defenses. Quarters against 2x2, Palms against trips, and the checks for bunch, empty and motion.

book.note: every front and every call on the sheet lives inside it

principles.title: MATCH IS AGGRESSIVE ZONE WITH RULES
principles.blurb: Not passive zone, not pure man. Zone defenders reading routes and reacting to whatever they get.

principles.title: MATCH KILLS THE META ROUTES
principles.blurb: Corners, crossers, deep posts. Quarters takes away every route people are living on right now.

principles.title: WHY SABAN BUILT HIS DEFENSE ON MATCH
principles.blurb: One defense with an answer for everything. Spread, empty, heavy. The rules adapt.

schemes.name: Alabama 3-4 Defense
schemes.subtitle: Crimson Tide · CFB 27
schemes.tagline: Control the line. Then bring everybody.

home.pitch: Three down and four backers on early downs, slide to Over Flex in the middle, bury them in the Mug on third and long.

book.note: every front and every call on the sheet lives inside it

principles.title: CONTROL THE LINE
principles.blurb: Three down, four backers. Win the line and the heavy sets die on first down.

principles.title: THE MIDDLE GROUND
principles.blurb: 335 Over Flex brings the extra DB and keeps the size. A nickel that still stops the run.

principles.title: OVERWHELM ON THIRD DOWN
principles.blurb: Load Dbl Mug on third and long. Two backers on the line, and the protection cannot count.

schemes.name: Baylor Veer N Shoot
schemes.subtitle: Baylor Bears · CFB 27
schemes.tagline: Spread them wide. Then go over the top.

home.pitch: Receivers split to the numbers, option routes that are right against every coverage, and a quarterback who is a weapon with his legs and his arm. All of it out of the Auburn playbook.

book.note: every formation and every call on the sheet lives inside it

principles.title: SPREAD THEM WIDE
principles.blurb: Receivers split all the way to the numbers, not to look different, but to make the defense declare before the snap.

principles.title: THE ROUTE IS ALWAYS RIGHT
principles.blurb: Option routes that decide after the snap. The receiver sees the coverage and finishes with the route that beats it.

principles.title: THE QUARTERBACK IS A WEAPON
principles.blurb: A quarterback who can take off or throw it sixty yards. The defense has to be right about both, and it cannot be.

schemes.name: Tennessee Veer N Shoot
schemes.subtitle: Tennessee Volunteers · CFB 27
schemes.tagline: Find the numbers. Take the shot.

home.pitch: Receivers split wider than anybody, a swing series and a stack where every play has a twin, and choice routes that make the deep shot the safe throw. All of it out of the Auburn playbook.

book.note: every formation and every call on the sheet lives inside it

principles.title: FIND THE NUMBERS ADVANTAGE
principles.blurb: Before every snap, find where we have more than they do, in the run game or the pass game, and attack it.

principles.title: USE THE WHOLE FIELD
principles.blurb: Split them out past the numbers and the defense has to cover every inch of the width, which leaves open grass for the run and the pass.

principles.title: CREATE EXPLOSIVE PASS PLAYS
principles.blurb: Once they are spread out and worried about the numbers, the shot is there, and the choice routes send it where the safeties are not.
